text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, Trainer-chan. Less of a 
consultation, and more like... there's 
something I need to confess to you.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, the truth is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of the Mile CS Nambu Hai, what 
Transcend told me was utterly 
unbelievable.
choice_data_list: You deleted the Cinema Gun data...!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well... call it youthful folly, but it's 
true that I felt like I shouldn't be 
collecting stuff like this...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, my bad. Too late for that 
now, though.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Do you really think a 
professional information broker like me 
would ever leave behind evidence?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...My bad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All files deleted... which means we'll 
have to run the Mile Championship Nambu 
Hai completely blind, with no data.
choice_data_list: Still... we have no choice but to do this.
Still... we have no choice but to do this.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's gonna be a tough battle, but 
still...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I can't go putting on an embarrassing race 
here, you know? Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I lost my weapon, morale remained 
high. After rigorous training, I arrived 
at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here it is, the Mile CS Nambu Hai! No 
matter what adversity may come—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
We can't let the traditional fanfare die 
out! Let's deliver a thrilling race to the 
northern country.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aargh... Looks like today's gonna be a 
pointless matchup.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I'm totally ready to beat 'em 
down, it's no fun if my top rival is all 
mopey..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Espo-o-on!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Let's do our 
best today! Let's make this the greatest 
race ever!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Mm? Tran, you look surprisingly energetic. 
What the heck happened?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a lot of things happened, but... Good 
news and bad news, which one do you want 
to hear first?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Spit 'em both out right now, dammit! After 
making us worry so damn much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Intimidated by Espoir City, Transcend 
recounted everything that had happened up 
to that point.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"So, the good news is that your motivation 
is totally hyped up..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So the bad news is, the smartphone videos 
are completely gone?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's not a smartphone video, but... 
broadly speaking... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. But whatever, who cares! All we gotta 
do is race. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"That ain't bad news at all! I'll show 'em 
what's what on the track!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trai-chan...
choice_data_list: It's fine! We'll just wing it!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! Got it!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(In the end, I couldn't race on-site this 
year... Even so...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(The same fanfare, the same finish line. 
So many people lent a hand so that these 
dreams would never fade...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(I don't have any data. Even so... I want 
to give it my all!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(This sky connects us all. So—I'll 
definitely deliver it to you!)
